items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 70:1
items.html: The ascent of MAN of Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna to AVI (as above in answer 156) joined AVI and Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna into one Partzuf, in which Yisrael Saba is included in the discernment of Aba, and Tevuna is included in the discernment of Ima, in the way explained above, page 670, Sub Header, ‘Adam HaRishon’; see there. For all the discernments explained regarding the ascent of ZON to the chamber of AVI, in order to beget the soul of Adam HaRishon, apply likewise to the ascent of Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna to the chamber of AVI, in order to beget ZA. And it was explained there that ZA becomes the discernment of Aba, and the Nukva the discernment of Ima, and the soul of Adam HaRishon was born from the discernment of ZON, and not from the discernment of AVI. So it is here too: although Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna were included and became the discernment of AVI, nevertheless ZON were born from Yisrael Saba ve Tevuna and not from AVI. And this is what the ARI is precise about above (p. 945, Item 148), that the place of the coupling and pregnancy is in the head of Tevuna; see there. (p. 943, Item 146)
